name: vali-valid
description: ValiValid — TypeScript form validation library for React. 63 built-in validators (string, numeric, date, file, array, geo, format, cross-field, async), a useValiValid hook with touchedFields, dirtyFields, handleBlur and validateOnBlur support, dynamic rule management at runtime, i18n (en/es), and a standalone ValiValid engine for server-side or non-React usage.
author: Felipe Rafael Montenegro Morriberon <teabajo_ubf@hotmail.com> (https://fm-portafolio.netlify.app/)
